import pandas as pd
app_path = './unzipped/Applicants.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(app_path)

allowed_langs = {'C++','C#','Fortran','Perl'}

def missing_count(row):
    missing = 0
    # Degree level only (Masters or PhD)
    if row['Degree Level'] not in ['Masters','PhD']:
        missing += 1
    # Experience
    if row['Experience (Years)'] < 3:
        missing += 1
    # Lab trained
    if str(row['Lab Trained (Y/N)']).strip().upper() != 'Y':
        missing += 1
    # Publications
    if row['Publications'] < 3:
        missing += 1
    # Citizen
    if str(row['Citizen (Y/N)']).strip().upper() != 'Y':
        missing += 1
    # Programming languages (expanded set)
    if str(row['Programming Lang']).strip() not in allowed_langs:
        missing += 1
    # Second language present
    if pd.isna(row['Second Language']) or str(row['Second Language']).strip() == '':
        missing += 1
    return missing

df['Missing Qualifications'] = df.apply(missing_count, axis=1)
count_one_missing = int((df['Missing Qualifications'] == 1).sum())
print('Number of applicants missing exactly one qualification:', count_one_missing)
